documents.text: ### `requestTimeout` + Default: `0` (no limit) Defines the maximum number of milliseconds for receiving the entire request from the client. See [`server.requestTimeout` property](https://nodejs.org/dist/latest/docs/api/http.html#serverrequesttimeout) to understand the effect of this option. When `serverFactory` option is specified, this option is ignored. It must be set to a non-zero value (e.g. 120 seconds) to protect against potential Denial-of-Service attacks in case the server is deployed without a reverse proxy in front. > ℹ️ Note: > At the time of writing, only node >= v14.11.0 supports this option

### `maxRequestsPerSocket` + Default: `0` (no limit) Defines the maximum number of requests a socket can handle before closing keep alive connection. See [`server.maxRequestsPerSocket` property](https://nodejs.org/dist/latest/docs/api/http.html#servermaxrequestspersocket) to understand the effect of this option. This option only applies when HTTP/1.1 is in use. Also, when `serverFactory` option is specified, this option is ignored. > ℹ️ Note: > At the time of writing, only node >= v16.10.0 supports this option.

request.instructions: The documents are sections of the documentation of ONE open-source project at one commit. Report a conflict only when two sections make incompatible statements about the SAME option, flag, default value, limit, version requirement, or behavior, for the same product version and scope. These are NOT conflicts: values of different options; example values in code samples that merely override a default; statements explicitly scoped to an older version or to migration history; one section giving more detail than the other; different defaults that the text ties to different contexts (per-route vs global, dev vs build, agent mode vs server mode).
